# `redundant-boolean-if`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports an `if` expression whose branches merely return a boolean condition or
its negation.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The conditional duplicates logic already represented by the condition and
obscures the value being computed.

## When it fires

It applies to simple boolean-producing branches that can be replaced without
changing evaluation or control flow.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn isAdult(age: u32) bool {
    if (age >= 18) {
        return true;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}
```
